description: A label isn't normalized, so a call of its NFC form doesn't find the function
notes: The label is e followed by U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT, and the call writes U+00E9, its NFC form. The spec says the language does not normalize identifiers, and doesn't say whether a quoted label is normalized (see native/structure/block-label-not-normalized), and the README doesn't say how a label names a function. hashicorp/hcl keeps the label as written (parser.parseQuotedStringLiteral in hclsyntax/parser.go), declares the function under it (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), and looks functions up by exact name (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
